scope: Fixed own whole/partial accumulator status-pipeline windows. Simulator evidence is independently checked against primary timing and flag expectations;16 partial-read windows remain unqualified. Not physical bus phases, complete DSP56371 mapping, boot or silicon equivalence.
primary_sources: DSP56300FM3.5.2/5.4.1.2 table5-1/A-1/A.2.3; primary download identities are in hardware/sources.json.
transport_controls: Full program readback before/after;1705 native PC transitions;64 SR/bus-value pairs; nonzero independent X/Y memory canaries.
